m_questTitle: With All the Dying Trees I Scream

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Good to see you again, Wizard. You need my Springleaf to help Bartleby? Absolutely! Here, take it with my blessing!
Hello, Wizard! You need my Springleaf? I sensed that Life Magic was strong with you, but I had no idea you could be Scion material!
Take my first Springleaf with my blessing, old friend. Good luck with the Arboreal Ritual. And please, help our Bartleby!
Dearest Wizard! I do wish we were meeting under better circumstances, but please, take my Springleaf. Just help Bartleby!
Wizard! You need my Springleaf? I sensed that Myth Magic was strong with you, but I never imagined you might be Bartleby's Scion!
Take my first Springleaf with my blessing, old friend. Good luck with the Arboreal Ritual. I do hope you can help Bartleby!
Hello, Wizard! I'm so glad it's you that has come to help us all. Please, take this Springleaf with my fiery blessing.
Hello, Wizard! You need my Springleaf? I sensed that your Fire Magic was strong, but I had no idea you could be Scion material!
Take my first Springleaf with my fiery blessing, old friend. Good luck with the Arboreal Ritual. I sure hope you can help Bartleby!
You seek my Springleaf? So you are to attempt the Arboreal Ritual? The news gives me chills! My Springleaf is all yours.
Hi, Wizard! You need my Springleaf? Wow. I always knew your Ice Magic was strong, but to potentially be Bartleby's Scion? That's cool!
Take my first Springleaf with my icy blessing, old friend. Good luck with the Arboreal Ritual. I sure hope you can help Bartleby!
The word on the wind is that you're going to attempt the Arboreal Ritual. That's electrifying! My Springleaf is yours. Just help Bartleby!
Hello, Wizard! You need my Springleaf? I sensed that your Storm Magic was exceptionally strong, but I had no idea you could be the Scion!
Take my first Springleaf with my blessing, old friend. Just help Bartleby!
Forgive me, Wizard. I'm in no mood to chat. Death stalks the Great Tree, and I'm powerless to help Him. What's that?
You are going to attempt the Arboreal Ritual? Then you will need my Springleaf! Take it with my blessing!
Can I help you, Wizard? You seek my Springleaf? So, you're going to try your hand at the Arboreal Ritual, hmm?
I recognized your exceptional Death Magic skills early on, but I never dreamed you might one day attempt the Arboreal Ritual!
For the first time in, well, ever, I have hope for the future. I believe in you, old friend. My Springleaf is yours. Just help Bartleby!
Oh, hello. It's been far too long! What brings you back to our sandy section of the Spiral? You're going to attempt the Arboreal Ritual?!?
Then you're going to need my first Springleaf, I suppose? It's all yours. I've a good feeling this will be the last time I'll be giving one out!
Hello, Wizard! You need my Springleaf? I sensed that your Balance Magic was exceptionally strong, but I had no idea you might be the Scion!
Take my first Springleaf with my blessing, old friend. Just help Bartleby!
To complete the Arboreal Ritual, you must collect the First Springleaf from each of the original Spell Trees. Go. Run!
Ah good, you have all seven Springleaves. According to the ancient texts, you now have everything you will need to perform the Arboreal Ritual...
The Altar where the Arboreal Ritual is conducted is guarded by Ancient forest spirits-
Wizard! Complete the Ritual. Mellori is the Key! I cannot hold it back... Help me! Help her. Just hurry!
There's no time to waste! Moolinda, prepare the Wizard for the Arboreal Ritual. I must consult with the Arcanum and the Council of Light.
Go fulfill your destiny, Wizard. Hold tight, dear Bartleby. Help is on the way! We hope.
Collect the First Springleaf from each of the original Seven Spell Trees. Don't forget Niles in Krokotopia!
